text.description_html:
Acorn RIYBQ, Iron Bean Tip Offset Cabinet Strap Hinge

The 6" Rough Iron Strap Hinge is suitable for light weight doors or cabinets. Its old world charm is in both the bean tip design and in the rough iron finish which duplicates the texture of naturally weathered iron. Available in both a flush and an offset variety. The Rough Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge has a lifetime no rust warranty. Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Also Available: Flush Rough Iron Cabinet Bean Tip Strap Hinge and Acorn 6" Smooth Iron Cabinet Strap Hinges

Specifications for the Acorn Bean Tip Cabinet Strap Hinge:

  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish mounting screws.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Features of the 3/8" Offset Bean Tip Strap Cabinet Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • Material: Iron
  • Length: 6"
  • Width: 1-3/4"
  • For doors whose face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Sold as a pair (2-hinges).
